## Review: ACCEPT · PR #23066 (draft, head `72443a3c`) · director seat dispatching on the maintainer's order, 2026-10-12T15:38Z

Checked on GitHub and on the head's tree, not on the report's say-so:
- **PR shape:** exists, draft, base `main` (merge-base `0cbfb7c3`), body line 1 `Fixes #23059` (the only closing keyword), `Clause-②: no`, assignee `os-zhuang`, labels `ci/cd`, `size/xl`, `skip-changeset`; 3 files, +1,360/−14, six commits; the newest `Claim:` (6126539555) names the branch and the queue guards `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` and `No other open PR may claim the same issue` are green.
- **The ⛔ list holds:** the diff touches `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`, `select-shard-timings-run.mjs` and `shard-timings-refresh.yml` only; `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs` (formula, `CEILING_FLOOR_SECONDS`, `RULED_CEILING_RAISES`), `partition-test-shards.mjs`, `ci.yml` and `lint.yml` are untouched. The refresh workflow's `on:` block (`schedule` `30 5 * * 1`, `workflow_dispatch`, `pull_request` on its three paths) and its write step are byte-unchanged; the one new step (`Download the window's per-file timing captures for the pull request body`, `if: steps.compare.outputs.changed == 'true'`) guards every command that can fail with a `::warning::` and `continue`, so it cannot red the job; the compose step runs `--diff` against `git show HEAD:scripts/test-shard-timings.json` and, on a refusal, puts the refusal text in the body's place and still opens the PR.
- **Items 2–3 as ruled, read in the code:** `RISE_FACTOR` = `DENSITY_COMPARABLE_FACTOR` = `CEILING_HEADROOM` (1.25), `FILE_BUDGET_SECONDS` = 10 (lines 175, 219–221); the five verdicts `finding` / `density only` / `provisional` / `no prior share` / `baseline` (lines 1037–1041); comparable density is a number (two windows' mean executed-package count within 1.25×; the self-test pins 20 vs 25 comparable and 20 vs 25.1 not, and 4 vs 5 per run comparable at line 2607); the density guard: a rise whose share moved by less than 1.25× is `density only`; the first diff after landing is a BASELINE and the body says why. The header section `REGRESSION DETECTION LIVES HERE, AND WHO FILES WHAT` (workflow lines 158–200) says the bot files nothing, nothing is ever a red build, and the seat landing the refresh PR files one card per `finding` with a `Protects:` line; the body's own `What the seat landing this PR does` section repeats it with the run's list.
- **The replay, reproduced by the seat** from a detached worktree of `72443a3c` over the #22368 dataset (`04018475`) and the #22923 dataset (`1bd612bd`): exit 0, `12 rise(s) of 1.25x or more, 0 finding(s) (BASELINE: none judged); 33 down; files over budget NOT MEASURED`; the rows match the PR body (`trigger-api` 2.18 → 23.85 s, 10.94×; `plugin-auth` 359.89 → 465.63 s; `service-settings` 73.71 → 92.33 s); the body's four sections render as described.
- **The dataset's new `density` key breaks no reader:** `partition-test-shards.mjs` `loadTimings` reads `packages` and `secondsPerTestFileFallback` and ignores the rest; `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs` reads `ceilings`; `report-test-timings.mjs` reads the pinned weights; none validates the key set. `timing_artifact_ids` on the selector's candidates sits outside `runIsEligible`'s `reasons` (the two `reasons.push` sites are the jobs and the run-summary artifacts).
- **Gates on the head `72443a3c`, read at this act:** green: `Lint & Repo Gates` (with `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `scoped · tooling self-tests`, `repo & tooling gates`, `docs & code guards`, `CI, release & engine gates`, `slot lookup & corpus`, `query-options erasure`, `ESLint`), `TypeScript Type Check` (workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger), `Test Core` 2/6–6/6, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, the three claim and single-writer guards, and **`Regenerate the shard-timings dataset`** (the lane's own `pull_request` dry run: the real selection, regeneration, capture download and `--diff` against `main`'s dataset, its would-be body in the step summary; the seat cannot read a job summary over REST, so the body's content from that run is the maintainer's reading in the web UI); still running: `Test Core (1/6)` and its aggregator; skipped by design: `Build Core`, `Build Docs` (no package touched). Nothing red. The dev's local union: 51 derived, 51 run, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 unrun; both self-tests OK with their floors raised to the registered counts; two ablations red in the predicted direction.
- **Tier and review face:** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 23066` finds no register row (1,374 lines ≤ 3000); the round's Tier H posture for `.github/workflows/**` is the maintainer's word, so the PR stays a draft until a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` member approves, then the seat readies and arms the queue. Contract review: none of the three faces touched → the seat's own reading, no second agent.
- **A false sub-premise, the route changed under the ruling's intent, accepted:** the dataset carries no per-file reading (its keys are listed in the PR body); `Slowest file:` comes from the per-shard `test-core-timings-N-of-6` captures of the same runs, retained as long as the run summaries (measured on run 38195222269). The per-file list is still a read of an existing measurement, not a new one; the two deviations it forced (the selector carries the capture ids; the download step) are proportionate and named.
- **The card-filing interpretation, confirmed by the seat under ruling E's "card filing is the seat's act":** files over budget are filed as one card per owning package naming its files (not one card per file), and a package or file with an open card gets the new numbers there as a comment. The maintainer may strike this.
- **Deviations accepted:** the `dispatch-gates: no-path-population` marker and the joined capture-schema string (the remedy `check:declared-population-live` prescribes); the "brake fired on main" sentence rewritten as a reading (the seat's relay from the #23058 dev). Writes: 3 relay strokes (pr_create, label-write, the report 6127459459) and the pushes; `mcp_calls` 0.
- **Out of scope, stays as is:** the workflow header's older paragraph still says `Test Core` "grades every executed package" (stale under ruling E; cosmetic; carrier none).

**Landing:** on `Test Core` green and the maintainer's Approve, the seat readies the PR and arms the queue. **NOT MEASURED until then: a live refresh.** The lane writes to `main` on its Monday 05:30 UTC schedule; the first refresh after landing is a BASELINE (the previous dataset carries no `density`) and its body carries the three lists with the first real density tags and files over budget; the seat reads it, files the per-package cards for files over 10 s, and judges nothing until the next comparable window. This card stays `pm:dispatched` until the landing record.

**LANDED — PR #23066 is MERGED (2026-10-12T21:57Z, approved by the maintainer, review 5496222580 on head `72443a3c`, readied, auto-merge armed and enqueued by hand; merge commit `d0f1c5bf`) and read in place on `origin/main` `d0f1c5bf`.** Director seat, summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`, 2026-10-12T21:58Z.

| the selector carries `timing_artifact_ids` | present | 4 references |
| the refresh workflow: the header section `REGRESSION DETECTION LIVES HERE, AND WHO FILES WHAT`, the capture-download step, `--diff` in the compose step, the cron `30 5 * * 1` unchanged | all | all |
| `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs`, `partition-test-shards.mjs`, `ci.yml` untouched by this merge (diff against `56986e9d`) | empty | empty |
| the dataset on `main` still carries no `density` (the first refresh after this is a BASELINE) | 10 keys, no `density` | as expected |

- The card was closed by the PR's `Fixes` line (`closed_by_pull_requests` lists PR #23066 alone); `pm:dispatched` stripped and the assignee released in this act. Items 2–4 of ruling E on #22949 are on `main`; with #23058's landing (`56986e9d`) the whole ruling is executed.
- **Owed on this card (the card's acceptance), NOT MEASURED until then:** the first scheduled refresh (Monday 2026-10-19, 05:30 UTC) opens a bot PR whose body starts with the regression readings: a BASELINE (the previous dataset carries no `density`), the window's density tags, the rises as readings, and the test files over 10 s from the window's captures. The seat reads it, files one card per owning package for the files over budget (the interpretation confirmed in ACCEPT 6127535812; the maintainer may strike it) and judges no rise until the next comparable window.
- The queue closed no other card: PR #23066's body carries `Fixes #23059` alone.
